name: MLPRender_Fea
definition: A neural rendering module that predicts RGB color from input features, view directions, and positions using a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) with positional encoding applied to features and view direction, but NOT position.
summary: MLPRender_Fea is a neural rendering module that predicts RGB color from pre-computed spatial features and view directions, distinguishing itself by excluding 3D position to separate spatial structure from appearance modeling.
